feeds.title: Black Voice News
feeds.description: Established in 1999 by Brown Publishing Company, Black Voice News is the oldest African-American online news publication on the West Coast. Originally launched as the online version of the California-based advocacy newspaper Black Voice News, the redesigned website was unveiled in 2015 as a platform for creative and concise content that informs + inspires.
